hero.subtitle: Lumalia brings together players from all horizons around unique experiences. One account, several universes, one community.

universes.label: 01 · The universes
universes.title: Three worlds, one address
universes.subtitle: Each Lumalia universe has its own atmosphere, community and rules. It's up to you to choose where to settle.
universes.crystal: A living world, built for long-term survival and group projects.
universes.onyx: The Lumalia experience, accessible from mobile and consoles, with no compromise.
universes.green: Our North American universe, with events designed for the US timezone.
